evidence: Adds `getMemoryLoad()` to `src/interfaces/mining.h` and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`, with functional tests in `test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py` and disconnect handling during shutdown.
rationale: Extends the mining IPC interface to expose memory load tracking with an external consumer waiting to use it. Stratum v2 template providers consume this interface over IPC, and the PR also ensures asynchronous template cleanup completes safely on disconnect during shutdown.
